specificFindings: Questions1-11 distinguish Yoshi from narrator and Korean student; ages, dates, cities and seasons are not interchanged.
Question10 preserves the intentional nominal seasonal list rather than inventing a verb.
Questions15-18 treat Donna Tartt quotation as open questions and author evaluation, not an experimental result or endorsed sacrifice rule.
Question21 follows the book’s named research summary without a universal outcome guarantee.
Question22 retains Perhaps; question23 attributes would have called to the narrator, not a literal Sartre statement about the father.
Questions24-25 are biographical narrative, not advice about drugs or clinical causal claims; thirty-five years attaches only to adult celibacy.
limitations: Stable IDs remain candidate source segmentation units, not a finalized independent-sentence count.
This is the first authored batch of an unfinished whole-book evidence task; prepared does not mean published.
